findings.summary: Lifecycle references belonging to another task were ignored by candidate binding.
findings.failure_scenario: A candidate-bound report also cites lifecycle evidence under another task path.
findings.impact: Conflicting cross-task provenance could be inherited.
findings.minimum_fix: Parse every lifecycle task and candidate segment and reject mismatches.

findings.summary: Review evidence did not enforce the single classified P2 delivery-debt limit.
findings.failure_scenario: Multiple, unclassified, or scalar-classified accepted-risk findings pass promotion.
findings.impact: A batch of unresolved review debt could bypass the terminal policy.
findings.minimum_fix: Require at most one P2 and an exact marker in a canonical approval array.

findings.summary: Semantic-risk integrity controls were omitted from the protected risk inventory.
findings.failure_scenario: A future lower-risk task names the semantic-risk validator or pinned schema exactly.
findings.impact: Evidence-integrity policy could change without high-risk review.
findings.minimum_fix: Protect the validator and both pinned schema paths.

residual_risks: The protected inventory must be updated when new authority or evidence-integrity surfaces are introduced.

state_impact: Only M0-14 canonical acceptance is rebound after review.
source_of_truth_changes: Promotion evidence and future task risk classification fail closed for the reviewed cases.
feedback_plan: Protected CI and the terminal latest-head review validate the DeliveryHead.
blast_radius: Task planning and promotion evidence only; no product packages.
rollback_or_deletion_test: Focused adversarial cases fail if any of the three closures is removed.
systems_questions.system_model_summary: One bounded final review batch produces one replacement ProductCandidate and one promotion-only DeliveryHead.
